evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Do you have any other questions or any specific concerns or stressors about the moving process in general?' — asked, but only after extensive inventory intake, right before pricing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: She flagged a real worry about fragility (a mirror, a vintage bench, an antique suitcase-table) and the rep didn't just acknowledge it once — he circled back later in the call to specifically re-confirm and flag those exact items as special-consideration pieces needing extra care.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Both the estimate-variability framing and the self-prep tip landed clearly. No rate-commit line, no explicit pay-less-if-faster line, no 'does that feel fair' check.

top_strength: Extraordinary patience across a 33-minute call with an extremely detail-heavy, item-by-item inventory (a reptile cage, a water-ski bench, a vertical metal bookshelf) and multiple rate-comparison questions (Saturday/Sunday/weekday/holiday) — answered every one clearly without rushing her.
coaching_note: This is a genuinely strong call — the only real gaps are the missing quid pro quo framing and the late-landing agenda question; both are easy structural fixes that wouldn't cost any of the warmth that made this call work.
